name: codex-monitor
description: Event-driven CLI monitoring; delegate Desktop requests to a CLI task

interface.shortDescription: Monitor CLI tasks from a Desktop control conversation.
interface.longDescription: Configure a selected CLI-owned monitoring task, inspect events, pause routes, and explicitly reply to sources. Desktop requests stay in a discussion task and delegate execution to CLI. Requires the separately installed codex-monitor runtime.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use codex-monitor for event monitoring. If this is Desktop, use a separate CLI-owned monitoring task; verify its owner and resident before enabling routes.
